adjudication.evidence: Original N/E/U shows a sustained ~30 mm N, ~10 mm E, ~-18 mm U shift beginning near index 595 (P2), with interior observations consistently offset and no return within the reviewed interval; P1 at index 589 is an isolated point with small offsets inconsistent with a platform and lacks supporting interior observations. No opposing return is observed for P2, but the large, coherent offset across all axes with persistent interior values supports a genuine temporary platform starting at 595. The earlier indices (559–594) show smooth motion without step-like behavior, ruling out P1 as a platform.
